name: aqi_v0_output_bias
rationale: On the six calibration windows (1338 held-out observed entries), original version_0 with 100 imputations has a normalized median residual -0.00424 and a scale-weighted median -0.00420, with raw mean error -0.294. Inspecting the final scalar affine bias identifies a direct way to remove this small common offset. The final noise step has c_out approximately 0.5, so adding 0.008 to that one bias yields approximately +0.004 standardized units. Keep every other weight unchanged. This is derived exclusively from calibration; confirmation and test remain unseen.
